newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat Auto sales in Jan-May up 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fiat Auto sales in Jan-May up 8.2 pct.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat Auto's sales in the first five months of this year rose 8.2 percent to 1.12 million units, Fiat Group Chairman Cesare Romiti said.
Fiat's market share in Europe rose to 12.6 percent in May, taking the company from fifth place at the end of 1996 to second place among European car manufacturers.
In the four months to end April Fiat subsidiary Iveco saw truck sales fall 8.8 percent to 37,900 units from a year earlier. Romit attributed the fall to "delays in delivery above all in Italy."
New Holland reported a 16.1 percent rise in tractor sales in the first four months to 33,400 while earth-moving equipment sales amounted to 7,200 and sales of combine harvesters totalled 1,900.
